theses.subject: Semiconductors
theses.thesis: Semiconductors (cn_semis) exhibits the strongest combination of trend health within eligible themes—high durability (0.70), relatively broad participation (breadth 0.409), and uncrowded positioning. While the momentum rank is second to AI Compute & Optics, the momentum lens is not predictive; we lean on absolute trend continuation strictly as a volatility‑management posture, fully aware that the trend gate historically failed to cut drawdown here. Overweight only over cash/unrelated laggards while the trend regime holds, never a return forecast.
theses.dissent: The market’s backtest shows trend gate whipsaws – trending themes have historically reversed without the gate providing drawdown control. Chasing Semiconductors now could simply be buying into a false trend that will mean‑revert sharply.

falsifier.text: Semiconductors loses absolute‑trend eligibility (gate flips) OR breadth collapses below 0.2 within the horizon.
